content: PAT/API key best practice: narrowest-possible scopes (never full-access), 90-day rotation for personal tokens, immediate revocation on compromise/role-change/offboarding, store secrets in vault not plaintext config, weekly audits with alerting, automate creation+rotation via workflow enforcing scope/expiry defaults - directly informs Skillshare's token model (workspace/skill-scoped tokens with expiry + revocation + audit).
